title: Flight Controls — Outboard Flap Carriage Roller Change with Corrected Rigging Values

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Superseding bulletin for the outboard flap carriage roller change, carrying the corrected rigging values, a revised acceptance band and the additional carriage clamp, and covering the re-rigging of aircraft embodied against the cancelled bulletin.

sections.planning_reason: Wear measurements at the outboard carriage on high-cycle aircraft showed the track reaching its published limit at about nineteen thousand flight cycles rather than the thirty-two thousand assumed in the maintenance programme. Fourteen tracks were replaced early across the fleet in two years and two were found at the limit at an intermediate check. The earlier bulletin published rigging values taken from the inboard carriage, and four aircraft embodied against it were found with a flap asymmetry outside the acceptance band.
sections.description: The bulletin fits the softer-surface roller set to the outboard carriage so that wear is taken by the roller rather than by the track, re-rigs the flap to the corrected values and installs an additional carriage clamp. It also covers the re-rigging of aircraft embodied against the cancelled bulletin.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Extend the flap and support it on the trestle. Do the inspection task AMM-C-27-50-13-200-026-A and record the track wear before any work. Remove the outboard carriage roller set. Install the revised roller set in the carriage actuator assembly DEL97190-24 and re-shim the interface with the flap drive solenoid assembly D2750116570759. Remove the clamp sub-assembly D2750008046179 and install the additional carriage clamp supplied with the kit. Renew the washers AES606871-9E at the carriage pivot. Re-rig the actuator sub-assembly D2750008004169 to the corrected values in this bulletin, which supersede those published in the cancelled bulletin. Do the flap asymmetry test through the full travel and record the result against the revised acceptance band. Repeat on the other side. Retract the flap and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft from MSN C00273 to MSN C00750 with the delivered roller set, and to aircraft embodied against the cancelled bulletin, which must be re-rigged before further flight. Aircraft from MSN C00750 onward are already at the standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K2750-2012-01 contains the roller sets, the additional carriage clamps, the shim pack and the fastener set. Kits delivered against the cancelled bulletin may be used with the carriage clamp ordered separately. Lead time is ten weeks.

type_data.compliance_time: Before further flight for aircraft embodied against the cancelled bulletin. At the next scheduled A-check, or within thirty months of the date of this Service Bulletin, for all other aircraft.

revision_history.reason: Initial issue superseding the cancelled bulletin, with corrected outboard rigging values
Acceptance band for the flap asymmetry test revised, and the additional carriage clamp added to the kit
